## Install Dependencies

### Linux

1. Update && Upgrade

for Ubuntu/Debian:
```{.bash}  
sudo update && Upgrade
```

for Archlinux:
```{.bash}  
sudo pacman -Syu 
```

for Rhel&Fedora:
```{.bash}  
sudo dnf upgrade --refresh
```

2. Install dependencies

for Ubuntu/Debian:
```{.bash}  
sudo apt install build-essential openmpi-bin libopenmpi-dev
```

for Archlinux:
```{.bash}  
sudo pacman -S gcc openmpi make 
```

for Rhel&Fedora:
```{.bash}  
sudo dnf install openmpi openmpi-devel gcc make 
```

3. Check g++ and mpi implementation

for Debian/Ubuntu, Archlinux:
```{.bash}  
which g++-15
g++-15 -v
mpicxx -v
```

for Fedora/Rhel:
g++ is usually only called as g++. Also before you can call mpicxx the system module has to be loaded.
```{.bash}
module load mpi/openmpi-x86_64
mpicxx -v
```

4. Get openLB

Via GitLab (install git first): 
```{.bash}
git clone https://gitlab.com/openlb/release.git
```

Via wget (in this case 1.9) refer to the link to the newest version at https://www.openlb.net/download/.
```{.bash}
wget https://zenodo.org/records/17899765/files/olb-1.9r0.tgz
tar xvfz olb-1.9r0.tgz
```

5. Use config files from OLB_ROOT/configs

6. To run your first simulation navigate in your terminal to an example (for example OLB_ROOT/examples/forBeginners/cylinder2d) and run (in this example)
```{.bash}
make clean && make
./cylinder2d
```

### MacOS 

1. Install homebrew package manager (also possible to use any other package manager for Mac)
```{.bash}
curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Homebrew/install/HEAD/install.sh
```

for Intel: 
```{.bash}  
echo 'eval "$(/opt/homebrew/bin/brew shellenv)"' >> ~/.zprofile
eval "$(/opt/homebrew/bin/brew shellenv)"
```
for Apple Silicon (M1,M2,M3 ...): 
```{.bash}  
echo 'eval "$(/usr/local/bin/brew shellenv)"' >> ~/.zprofile
eval "$(/usr/local/bin/brew shellenv)"
```

2. Use brew to install gcc (if desired) and gnumake, open-mpi (TODO: maybe also tinyxml and zlib ?)
```{.bash}
brew install gcc make open-mpi
```

3. Check installation of g++ and version
```{.bash}
which g++-15
g++-15 -v
```

4. Check mpi implementation
```{.bash}
mpicxx -v
```
Output should be TODO:

6. Set environment variables
```{.bash}
export OMPI_CXX=${which g++-15}
export OMPI_CC=${which gcc-15}
```

5. Use config.mk file in the directory OLB_ROOT/configs


### Windows

1. Open the powershell (Win+R and type in powershell + Enter)

2. install WSL by running the following in the powershell
```{.bash}
wsl --install
```

3. Reboot your system

4. After reboot you will might be greeted by a new console window. If not search in the start menu for Ubuntu

5. The installation will take some time and afterwards you will be promted to set ure Unix username and password.

6. Now follow the installation guide for Linux Ubuntu/Debian (1.1).
